PKG PRESIDENT ----ROLL SOT---- ----ROLL SOT---- “...the day he takes over from current president Chuck Staben.” 1-SHOT GRADES VO/SOT O/C DELANEY LOWER 3RD: POSSIBLE GRADING CHANGES THOUGH GREEN MAY NOT HAVE ANY OFFICIAL PLANS, THERE ARE CHANGES THAT WILL OCCUR DURING HIS PRESIDENCY. A RECENT PROPOSAL TO MOVE TO A PLUS MINUS GRADING SYSTEM AT THE UNIVERSITY OF IDAHO WAS APPROVED WEDNESDAY ALTHOUGH THE CHANGE WON’T OCCUR UNTIL 2023. THIS SHIFT IS CONTROVERSIAL, AND NOT ALL STUDENTS AND FACULTY MEMBERS ARE ON BOARD WITH THE CHANGE. SOME FEEL THAT THE SYSTEM DISPROPORTIONATELY HARMS HIGH-ACHIEVING STUDENTS. CURRENTLY, AN “A” GRADE IS 90 PERCENT AND ABOVE. WITH THE CHANGE, AN “A” WILL BE 94 PERCENT AND ABOVE. HOWER, THOSE WITH A HIGH “B,” “C,” OR “D” GRADE WOULD BENEFIT WITH A SLIGHTLY HIGHER GPA. PROFESSOR STEVE SMITH IN THE JAMM DEPARTMENT, HOWEVER, SAYS THIS NEW SYSTEM IS MORE TROUBLE THAN IT’S WORTH. ----------ROLL SOT---------- TRT= :23 OUTCUE “…sweating over an 85 or an 88” DELANEY CHUCK STABEN STILL HAS TO OFFICIALLY APPROVE THE CHANGE FOR IT TO TAKE EFFECT. PKG PARKING -----ROLL PKG---- -----ROLL PKG---- 2-SHOT TOSS DELANEY: THE SPRING SPORTS SEASON IS WINDING DOWN, HERES NOAH PORTER WITH THE LATEST. 1-SHOT SPORTS O/C NOAH LOWER 3RD: THANK YOU DELANEY. THE IDAHO VANDALS HAD THEIR SPRING FOOTBALL GAME ON APRIL 19, ALLOWING PLAYERS TO GET GAME SPEED ACTION WHILE THE COACHES GOT TO EVALUATE THEIR OWN PLAYERS. VO FOOTBALL SPRING GAME SENIOR WIDE RECEIVER JEFF COTTON HAD AN INCREDIBLE GAME, CATCHING 13 PASSES FOR 217 YARDS. MASON PETRINO LED THE QUARTERBACKS, COMPLETING 17 OF 22 PASSES FOR 307 YARDS AND 3 TOUCHDOWNS. THE GOLD TEAM CAME OUT ON TOP, 70-20. 1-SHOT TOSS O/C NOAH STAYING ON THE TOPIC OF FOOTBALL, FORMER IDAHO LINEBACKER KADEN ELLISS WAS SELECTED AT PICK 244 IN THE 7TH ROUND IN THE 2019 NFL DRAFT BY THE NEW ORLEANS SAINTS. VO ELLISS KADEN ELLISS FOOTAGE ELLISS HAD AN OUTSTANDING CAREER WITH THE VANDALS, HAVING 278 TOTAL TACKLES, 17 SACKS, AND 5 INTERCEPTIONS. HE ALSO CONTRIBUTED ON OFFENSE, CATCHING 10 PASSES IN HIS TWO YEARS AS A PART OF THE VANDAL OFFENSE. KADEN DEMONSTRATED WHAT IT MEANT TO BE A GOOD TEAMMATE ON AND OFF THE FIELD, AND SHOWED HUMILITY THROUGH THE WHOLE PROCESS. 1-SHOT BASKETBALL O/C NOAH THE VANDAL MEN’S BASKETBALL TEAM WILL NEED TO FIND SOME REPLACEMENTS THIS OFFSEASON, AS CAMERON TYSON, GENO WEST, LOSINI KAMARA, AND CASSIUS SMITS-FRANCISCO ARE ALL PLANNING TO TRANSFER SCHOOLS. VO BASKETBALL TRANSFER FOOTAGE CAMERON TYSON IS THE ONLY PLAYER WHO HAS PICKED HIS SCHOOL, AS HE HAS SIGNED WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF HOUSTON, A TEAM WHO MADE THE SWEET 16 IN THIS YEAR’S TOURNAMENT. THE VANDALS WILL HAVE SOME NEW FACES THIS YEAR, AND ONE OF THOSE FACES IS JACK WILSON, A 7-FOOT CENTER FROM SAN MATEO, CALIFORNIA, WHO PLAYED AT OREGON STATE LAST SEASON. WILSON WAS A 3 STAR RECRUIT COMING OUT OF HIGH SCHOOL, AND WAS RANKED 282ND IN THE COUNTRY IN 2016. 1-SHOT SPORTS CLOSE O/C NOAH THAT’S ALL WE HAVE FOR SPORTS NEWS.
